purpose: Teach: 如何なる/原著/生い立ち/懇願/物言い/卵子/破局/公道

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、如何なる市場変動にも対応できる体制を整えろ
lines.en: Set our company up to handle whatever the market throws at us.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening. Eyes moving across the room — this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営書の原著を役員に推薦します
lines.en: Understood. I'll recommend the original management texts to the executive team.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Slight nod embedded in the voice. Not rushing — absorbing the order and already mentally organizing next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の生い立ちを社員研修で語れ
lines.en: Our company will share the founder's story during staff training.
lines.style: Flat, authoritative delivery. This is a decision stated as fact, not open for discussion. Slight pause before 'will' — the weight of expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引先からの納期短縮の懇願に応えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll respond to our clients' requests for shortened deadlines.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment. Faster tempo than before — action-oriented. No hesitation, no second-guessing. The voice of someone already moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質への物言いに迅速に対応しろ
lines.en: Our company must respond quickly to any quality concerns.
lines.style: Sharp, emphatic. Slightly raised volume on 'quality.' This is the line that matters most — delivered with visible gravity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バイオ事業の卵子関連製品を慎重に扱います
lines.en: Understood. I will handle the biotech division's egg-related products with appropriate care.
lines.style: Measured, cautious. Slower pace on 'egg-related' — marking the sensitivity of this product category. Respectful weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の破局シナリオに備えろ
lines.en: Our company needs contingency plans for worst-case industry scenarios.
lines.style: Low, serious tone. Leans forward slightly in the delivery. This is not panic — it's seasoned realism. No inflection changes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用車の公道走行ルールを遵守します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure all company vehicles follow public road regulations.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Slightly slower close, like sealing a commitment. Formal but not stiff — the closing of a directive session.
